subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Affront
solution:
The correct answer is "**Insult**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In the first place, we will take a look at the meaning of the given words: 

__
 
• 
 **Affront**: something that you say or do that is **insulting** to somebody/something. (ऐसा कुछ जो आप कहते हैं या करते हैं जो किसी के लिए अपमानजनक है/कुछ।)

 
 
• Example: *The suggestion that he may be required to change his clothes seems to affront him.*
 
 
 
• **Insult**: to speak or act **rudely** to somebody; a rude **comment** or action. (किसी के साथ अशिष्टता से बात करना या कार्य करना; एक अशिष्ट टिप्पणी या कार्रवाई)
 
 
• Example: *When I didn't even receive a response to my question, I felt quite insulted.*
 
 
 
• Apparently, the above elucidation shows that the words 'affront' and 'insult' are** similar** in their **meaning**.
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is:* Insult​*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Lets understand the implication of the remaining words:

__
 
• **Depress**: to make somebody** unhappy** and without hope or enthusiasm. (किसी को नाखुश और आशा या उत्साह के बिना बनाने के लिए)

 
 
• Example: *I get so depressed just thinking about leaving home.*
 
 
 
• **Fall**: to **drop down** towards the ground. (जमीन की ओर गिरना)
 
 
• Example: *She suffered a terrible fall from her bicycle.*
 
 
 
• **Tolerate**: to allow or **accept** something that you do not like or agree with. (किसी ऐसी चीज को अनुमति देना या स्वीकार करना जिसे आप पसंद नहीं करते या इससे सहमत नहीं हैं)
 
 
• Example: *We must tolerate viewpoints that are dissimilar to our own in a joint family.*
